Communications, Copywriting & Storytelling

Who we are

About Privy

Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. We build simple, flexible application programming interfaces (APIs) and tools that help developers create products on crypto infrastructure.

Privy provides the abstraction and infrastructure layer above wallets, integrating across blockchain networks, third-party providers, and Stripe products such as Treasury and Link. We solve complex technical problems while using Stripe’s global reach to support customers including Ramp, Klarna, Deel, Kraken, Hyperliquid, and Fomo. Our technology powers experiences for both mainstream users and crypto-native audiences.

Learn more:  [Privy and Stripe: Bringing crypto to everyone ]

About the team

The Account Executive, Product team connects Privy’s technology with companies building new products across fintech and crypto. The team works closely with Product, Engineering, and Go-to-Market partners to understand prospective customers’ needs, shape technical and commercial solutions, and turn market insights into product and sales strategy. Its focus includes priority segments such as neobanking, payments, and brokerages. 

What you’ll do

As an Enterprise Account Executive you’ll own complex enterprise sales cycles and help expand Privy’s work with companies across fintech and crypto. You’ll build relationships with senior commercial and technical stakeholders, develop new opportunities, and help refine Privy’s enterprise sales approach. You’ll also contribute to Privy’s global growth strategy and represent the company at industry events.

Responsibilities

• Partner with the Head of Go-to-Market (GTM) to build and close a strong pipeline of enterprise prospects.

• Develop and test outbound campaigns based on market and customer feedback.

• Manage a pipeline across multiple ideal customer profiles.

• Build deep expertise in Privy’s products and lead discovery calls with fintech prospects to understand their needs and explain Privy’s value.

• Own the full sales cycle, from sourcing opportunities through contract close, and serve as the primary commercial contact for prospective customers.

• Contribute to the Go-to-Market team’s strategy across North America and other global markets, including Latin America, Asia, and Africa.

• Analyze market trends and emerging opportunities to inform Privy’s positioning and sales strategy.

• Represent Privy at industry events and conferences as a spokesperson for its fintech business.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 5 to 10 years of experience in sales, business development, or a related field, including experience selling a technical product and a record of strong performance.

• You have experience selling technical products within fintech, crypto, or a related industry. You can build a pipeline, lead complex sales cycles, and develop trusted relationships with commercial and technical stakeholders.

• Experience leading complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals involving legal, compliance, engineering, and other buyer-side teams through contract close.

• Ability to work effectively in an early-stage environment and build repeatable processes where none exist.

• Experience building strong networks within a specific industry, ideally fintech, payments, or crypto.

• Strong communication, negotiation, relationship management, and sales skills.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience selling API-first or developer-focused products.

• Ability to lead discovery conversations with technical buyers, including chief technology officers and product leaders.

• Familiarity with crypto infrastructure, such as stablecoins, on-ramps and off-ramps, wallets, and custody, or a demonstrated ability to learn the space quickly.

This intelligence is delivered to 23,000+ federal, state, and local agencies, serving one million first responders. As an AI Engineer on this team, you’ll own core capabilities end to end-from model behavior and backend architecture to evaluation tooling. title: Principal Product Manager
description:
Principal Product Manager

Position Summary

Natera is at the forefront of personalized genetic testing, transforming the management of disease worldwide. As we scale our life-saving diagnostics, we are fundamentally transforming how software products are conceived, built, and delivered across our clinical and genomic portfolio.

We are seeking an experienced Principal Digital Product Manager to join our Oncology Comprehensive Genomic Profiling (CGP) Product Engineering team. In this senior individual contributor role, you will serve as the product lead for our most complex platform initiatives - owning end-to-end product strategy and execution across a sophisticated system of interconnected software products.

You will act as the product backbone for our most critical "Pillar" projects. Success in this role demands mastery from three dimensions: partnership with commercial teams to define product strategy/roadmap based on market needs; deep fluency in how end users - lab operations, clinical teams, customer success teams - actually work; and close collaboration with Engineering, R&D, and PMO on product design and delivery. You will synthesize all three into product decisions that hold up end-to-end - from order ingestion through lab execution to patient reporting - ultimately delivering reliable, high-quality solutions that patient care depends on.

Crucially, while this is an individual contributor role, you will operate as a central leader - driving consensus, roadmap alignment, and product excellence through influence rather than formal authority across Engineering, R&D, Commercial, and Clinical teams. You thrive in fluid environments, adapt quickly to change, and chart a clear path forward even amid unknowns.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Vision

•  Define Long-Term Vision: Develop and execute multi-year software product roadmaps for critical business units, balancing rapid prototyping with long-term commercial stability.

•  Architect Complex Solutions: Act as a high-level Architect, translating broad business goals into detailed functional workflows. You are accountable for the cohesion and integrity of the final end-to-end solution.

•  Founder's Mindset: Champion a culture of high agency and urgency, making quick, data-driven decisions in ambiguous situations to deliver critical milestones in a fast-paced environment.

•  Cross-Functional Influence: Lead by expertise rather than authority, aligning stakeholders across R&D, Engineering, Operations, Quality, and Regulatory to ensure the software roadmap meets broader business goals.

Product Excellence & Execution

•  End-to-End Ownership: Lead the full product lifecycle for complex software solutions, ensuring a seamless user journey across various system boundaries - from order ingestion through lab execution to patient reporting.

•  Technical Translation: Serve as the primary domain expert, translating complex scientific, clinical, or technical requirements into robust, scalable software specifications.

•  Operational Immersion: Passionately advocate for internal and external users by regularly shadowing operations and engaging with customers to ensure software solves real-world physical and clinical problems.

•  Systems Thinking: Maintain a "big picture" view of how software systems interact across the entire data lifecycle, understanding how upstream decisions ripple through to downstream clinical and reporting outcomes.

•  Agile Mastery: Lead with the rigor of a seasoned project manager, owning product backlogs and driving Agile ceremonies to ensure timely delivery of high-quality features.

•  AI-Native Product Development: Pioneer the use of LLMs and generative AI tools to accelerate product discovery, automate requirements synthesis, and continuously improve how we deliver value to users.

title: [Job 31517] Data Scientist SR
description:
Perfil que Buscamos

Experiência prévia em squads de produto digital, preferencialmente em personalização, recomendação ou CRM inteligente
Mentalidade de produto: você não entrega modelo, você entrega resultado de negócio
Conforto em trabalhar com dados transacionais e operacionais (não apenas clickstream ou Analytics)
Familiaridade com o conceito de identidade unificada de cliente e desafios de resolução de entidades (entity resolution)
Senso crítico para distinguir quando um modelo de ML é a resposta certa - e quando uma regra bem calibrada resolve melhor

Responsabilidades

Modelagem de contexto e intenção do cliente - desenvolver modelos de classificação, propensão e detecção de eventos comportamentais em tempo (near) real
Next Best Action (NBA) - construir e evoluir a lógica de priorização de ações e comunicações por cliente, orientada ao contexto e não a regras comerciais estáticas
Feature Engineering para eventos transacionais - transformar eventos sistêmicos (pagamentos, sinistros, renovações, interações) em features ricas para modelos de ML
Trabalhar junto à arquitetura para garantir que os sinais de segmentação e identidade sejam consumíveis pelo motor de contexto (ex.: CRM)
Experimentação e validação - desenhar e analisar experimentos A/B para avaliar o impacto das decisões de personalização nos KPIs de negócio
Documentação e governança - garantir rastreabilidade de modelos, versionamento e monitoramento de drift em produção

Requisitos obrigatórios

Sólida experiência com Python para análise e modelagem de dados (pandas, scikit-learn, PySpark)
Sólida experiência com algoritmos de ML supervisionado, especialmente modelos de classificação e ranking (XGBoost, LightGBM)
Experiência prática com processamento e consumo de eventos em tempo real, utilizando ferramentas como Kafka ou Kinesis
Experiência prática com o conceito de Feature Store e gestão de features para modelos em produção (Feast, Tecton, Hopsworks ou similares)
Experiência prática com A/B Testing e fundamentos de inferência causal aplicados a produtos digitais
Experiência prática com cloud (AWS ou GCP) para ingestão, armazenamento e processamento de dados (S3/GCS, BigQuery/Redshift, Glue/Dataflow)

Diferencial

Experiência com streaming de ML para inferência em tempo real (Flink, Spark Structured Streaming)
Experiência com LLMs e GenAI aplicados a contextos de personalização ou classificação de intenção do usuário
Experiência com ferramentas de orquestração de pipelines de dados (Airflow, Prefect ou similares)
Experiência com práticas de MLOps, incluindo versionamento, monitoramento de drift e deploy de modelos em produção (MLflow, Vertex AI, SageMaker)
Experiência com bancos de dados em grafo para modelagem de relacionamentos entre entidades como cliente, produto e canal (Neo4j ou similares)

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Compensation: The base salary for this role is between $80,000-$120,000 and varies based on location, experience, and skill set.
Description
We are hiring several Senior Software Engineers to work across the two halves of what we do: the managed WordPress, WooCommerce, and Magento hosting platform itself, and the WordPress products that run on it. We will work out the best fit with you during the interview process rather than asking you to choose up front.
Platform Cloud covers the hosting platform: provisioning and lifecycle, the PHP request path, caching layers, database performance, and the reliability of customer sites at scale. Products and Solutions covers our WordPress product portfolio: core APIs, the Block Editor, and writing upgrade-safe code that ships to an enormous and completely uncontrolled installed base.
What both tracks have in common is the person we are looking for: someone comfortable on both sides of the wp-config. You write the PHP, and you understand the server executing it. When a page is slow, you do not stop at "the plugin is slow" - you know whether it is a query plan, a cold object cache, a saturated PHP-FPM worker pool, or genuinely your code. That operational instinct is what separates this role from a typical WordPress job.
This is a permanently remote full-time position. We hire globally, wherever we can legally engage you. The one hard scheduling requirement is at least four hours of daily overlap with US Eastern time, roughly 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM ET, so you can pair, review, and respond alongside the rest of the team.
Responsibilities

• Own substantial features and systems end to end - design, implementation, testing, rollout, and what happens after rollout

• Build and ship across the platform and product surfaces that customers touch every day

• Diagnose and fix performance problems end to end, from a slow query, through the cache layer, to the response a visitor actually waits for

• Write PHP that survives contact with the real world: hostile plugins, ancient data, and site owners who will do things you did not anticipate

• Contribute to the consolidation and modernization of systems as we bring platforms together under one architecture, without breaking the sites already depending on them

• Design within our architecture, and know when to push back on it

• Break down ambiguous problems into work that can actually be shipped incrementally

• Write and maintain automated tests, treating them as part of the feature rather than an afterthought

• Participate in code review as a first-class activity - give feedback that makes the codebase better and the author stronger

• Improve the tooling, scripts, and pipelines that let the whole team ship with confidence, and automate the operational work that would otherwise be done by hand

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. ABOUT THE ROLE

Millions of people rely on Notion to do their most important work, and protecting that trust is foundational to everything we build.

We’re looking for a hands-on Detection Engineer to build and operate the systems and workflows we use to detect and respond to attacks across Notion’s cloud-native environment. You’ll ship high-signal detections, improve the platform that powers them, participate in incident response, and help shape how detection and response engineering scales at Notion.

You’ll work closely with Engineering, Corporate Security, and Infrastructure, with broad latitude to identify gaps, prioritize investments, and build what’s needed next.

WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

- Build and tune high-signal detections across cloud, identity, endpoint, and SaaS environments, with review and mentorship from senior teammates as you ramp up.

- Build tooling and automation that speed up triage, enrichment, investigation, and detection authoring, including LLM-based workflows where useful.

- Turn threat intelligence and adversary TTPs into detections, telemetry requirements, and response improvements.

- Take part in investigations, incident response, and postmortems, and help turn what we learn into lasting fixes.

- Help define and track metrics such as coverage, MTTD, and alert quality.

- Join a shared on-call rotation for incident response.

- We're hiring across a range of experience levels. If you have some of these skills but not all, we'd still like to hear from you.

- 3+ years of experience in detection engineering, security operations, incident response, threat hunting, or a closely related security or software engineering role.

- Have written or tuned detections that run in production, and care about signal quality and cutting noise.

- Working knowledge of at least one detection or query language (Sigma, KQL, SPL, YARA-L, EQL, or Panther), or strong SQL or Python skills and the drive to learn one quickly.

- An understanding of how attackers operate (for example, MITRE ATT&CK), and the ability to use it to decide what to detect.

- Hands-on experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure, ideally including identity and access logs.

- Have used SIEM, EDR, or SOAR tools in any size of environment.

- Write clearly in runbooks, design docs, and incident notes, and can own well-scoped projects end to end.

NICE TO HAVE

- Have led purple team, blue team, or adversary emulation exercises that improved detections or telemetry.

- Experience running SIEM, EDR, or SOAR platforms at large scale.

- Experience building or maintaining detection-as-code workflows (version control, CI, and tests for detections).

- Experience applying LLMs or agent-style tooling to security workflows.

- Experience securing AI-enabled systems or endpoint tooling.

description: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. This role is highly practical: you'll design training setups, run experiments in simulation, transfer policies to physical robots, and measure how they hold up. You'll get hands-on experience with the gap between a policy that works in simulation and one that keeps a robot on its feet on wet ground at night. WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON Train and evaluate reinforcement learning policies for locomotion and low-level control in simulation. Apply sim-to-real techniques such as domain randomization, reward design, and policy robustness methods, and test the results on physical robots.

About the role

We are looking for a detail-oriented QA/Test professional who can translate Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) and user Personas into concrete and testable workflows. The Software Quality Assurance Lead will map out how different user types move through the system end-to-end, design test strategies that validate those journeys, and ensure the product behaves correctly across all critical paths, including edge cases, role-based variations, and cross-functional handoffs.

What you'll do

Workflow Discovery & Mapping

• Analyze PRDs, user stories, and Persona documentation to identify all relevant user workflows.

• Create visual workflow/process maps (e.g., flowcharts, swimlane diagrams, BPMN) representing each Persona's journey through the system.

• Identify decision points, branching logic, and system dependencies within each workflow.

Test Strategy & Design

• Design comprehensive test plans and test cases covering each workflow end-to-end, including happy paths, edge cases, and failure/error scenarios.

• Define acceptance criteria in collaboration with Product Managers and Business Analysts.

• Prioritize testing based on risk, frequency of use, and business impact per Persona.

Execution

• Perform manual (and where applicable, automated) testing across workflows, systems, and integration points.

• Validate cross-role interactions (e.g., how Persona A's actions affect Persona B's workflow).

• Test across different environments, browsers/devices, and permission levels as needed.

Defect Management & Reporting

• Log, track, and prioritize defects; work with engineering to validate fixes.

• Maintain traceability between PRD requirements, Personas, workflows, and test coverage.

• Provide clear status reporting on workflow test coverage and quality risk areas.

Continuous Improvement

• Recommend improvements to workflows based on testing insights (usability gaps, inconsistent logic, missing edge-case handling).

• Build/maintain a repository of workflow test cases and Persona-based test scenarios for reuse and regression testing.

• Collaborate with automation engineers to identify workflows suitable for automated regression testing.

Skills & experience

• Proven experience in QA/software testing, ideally with a focus on process/workflow testing rather than just feature-level testing.

• Strong ability to read and interpret PRDs, user stories, and Persona documents, and translate them into structured test scenarios.

• Experience with process mapping tools (e.g., Lucidchart, Miro, Visio, BPMN tools).

• Solid understanding of test case design techniques (boundary testing, equivalence partitioning, scenario-based testing).

• Familiarity with test management tools (e.g., Jira, TestRail, Zephyr, Xray).

• Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills - able to spot gaps in logic or missing scenarios.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills for cross-functional collaboration (Product, Engineering, UX).

Nice to have

• Exposure to workflow/BPM engines (e.g., Camunda, Pega, custom workflow engines) - especially relevant if your system has a workflow engine (this could tie into your "NG platform" / workflow-engine work referenced in other contexts).

• Basic knowledge of API testing or automation framewo

title: Investment Banking Analyst
description:
We are hiring an Investment Banking Analyst to research, reach and book the investors behind the opportunities on Pairs.

Pairs is a global network of family offices, institutional investors, VCs and angels. We screen deal flow very tightly, and the opportunities that clear our diligence go out to the network. We invest alongside them too.

THE ROLE

This role sits on the investor side of Pairs. In banking you built the investor lists and drafted the outreach. Here you run it end to end: you find the right investors, open the conversation, and book them into meetings with founders whose opportunity fits.

The work rewards rigour. Every list is qualified before it is used, every message is written for the person receiving it, and every reply gets a next step.

We are not raising a fund. Our investors invest directly in companies, so the work is about family offices, high-net-worth individuals, angels and funds that back companies directly. Our model is introductions and relationship management, not deal execution.

Our platform handles the pipeline, research and follow-up. Your time goes to investor conversations, and to learning which investors are ready to commit capital.

You will work directly with the two co-founders and our investor team, on a process that already works. The organisation is flat, so you will see first-hand how we screen opportunities, what we decline and why.

This is an early-career role. The pace is high, and the people who do well here keep the quality high with it.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

- Investor lists. Who fits each opportunity by stage, sector, check size and recent activity, qualified before anyone is contacted.

- First conversations. Messages that read like a person wrote them, and replies turned into calls.

- Investor meetings. Qualified investors booked with founders, with the context they need before the call.

- Accurate records. Every conversation, meeting and outcome logged, so nothing is lost between calls.

YOU ARE A FIT IF YOU

- Have worked as an analyst in investment banking, M&A advisory, corporate finance or capital advisory, and have built investor or buyer lists on live processes.

- Know the difference between a long list and a qualified one, and can explain how you get from one to the other.

- Can write a short, specific message to a busy investor that gets a reply.

- Keep your pace high without letting quality slip, and follow a process without needing a reminder.

- Treat discretion as second nature. Please do not include any investor names in your application.

- Use AI tools daily, with clear judgement about where they improve your work and where they would compromise its quality.

WHAT WE OFFER

- A fully remote, asynchronous role

- Direct access to the co-founders and our investor team

- Close collaboration with our internal team

- Live mandates from your first week, and access to the opportunities that clear our diligence

- Insight into our internal processes, including how we screen deal flow

- Room to grow into a senior investor-side role as your network grows

- A base salary plus commission

title: Director of People & Culture (m/f/d)
description:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

At RobCo, we automate the ordinary, so humans can do the extraordinary. To achieve this, we are looking for an ambitious Director of People & Culture (m/f/d) to help us establish RobCo as leading provider of automation solutions.

Your Responsibilities

- Own RobCo's people strategy end-to-end, from vision to execution

- Build and lead a high-impact People function that scales with the business

- Scale hiring across engineering, GTM, and operations with speed and quality

- Design performance systems that drive accountability and results

- Raise the bar on people leadership across the company

- Be a strategic partner to the C-suite on org design, succession, and leadership development

- Build competitive, scalable compensation, equity, and benefits programs

- Operationalize culture and values so they reinforce execution

- Lead change as the company grows in size, geography, and complexity

- Run a KPI-driven People function, using data to monitor org health and guide every strategic decision

- Champion AI adoption to modernize and scale day-to-day People operations

We're looking for someone who has:

- Proven VP/Head of People experience in high-growth, venture-backed companies

- Track record scaling teams through rapid growth phases (e.g., Series B → D)

- Builder mentality: comfortable creating systems from scratch

- Sharp business judgment, executive presence, and a data-driven approach

- High standards for performance, talent, and leadership

- Ability to operate strategically and hands-on

- Genuine curiosity about emerging technology and a drive to innovate within People & Culture

Why join RobCo?

- Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.

- Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time.

- As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work.

- Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development.

- Work out across Germany in over 7,200 studios with our subsidized Wellpass membership.

- Flexible working hours, a modern office, and-depending on the role-the option to work from home.

- Regular team events-from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest.

About RobCo

Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that adapts to your use case, improves over time, and requires zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.

We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. With $160M raised from investors including Lightspeed, Lingotto Innovation, and Sequoia, 200+ people globally, and 2.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our RobCo Bay Area Demo Lab in San Francisco.

title: Finance Operations Intern (m/f/d)
description:
ÜBER BUENA

Buena digitalisiert die Hausverwaltung in Deutschland. Wir übernehmen traditionelle Hausverwaltungen und transformieren sie in moderne, technologiegetriebene Unternehmen - mit dem Ziel, Immobilienverwaltung einfach und transparent zu machen.

DEINE ROLLE

In deiner Rolle als Praktikant im Bereich Finance Operations bildest du das verlässliche Rückgrat unseres Finanzteams. Du steuerst die kompletten Abläufe der Kreditorenbuchhaltung, begleitest aktiv die Einführung frischer Systeme sowie Abläufe und agierst als maßgebliche Schnittstelle zu externen Steuerberatern. Gleichzeitig garantierst du reibungslose, strukturierte Prozesse in unseren Tochterunternehmen. An der Seite von Finance Lead und CFO erhältst du umfassende Einblicke in sämtliche Finanzstrukturen, vom einzelnen Beleg bis zur strategischen Liquiditätssteuerung.

WAS DU TUN WIRST

- Accounts Payable: Du managst unseren Eingangsrechnungs-Workflow von A bis Z - Postkorb, Invoice Chasing, Freigabeprozesse und Zahlungen ausführen. Sorgfalt und ein Auge für Details sind hier entscheidend.

- Buchungsqualität: Du stellst sicher, dass Rechnungen mit den richtigen Konten, Kostenstellen und Steuersätzen erfasst werden. Du bist die erste Instanz, bevor Buchungen zu unseren Steuerberatern gehen, und unterstützt bei buchhalterischen Rückfragen.

- Tochtergesellschaften: Du überprüfst regelmäßig die BWAs unserer Töchter, erkennst Abweichungen und Unplausibilitäten und stellst sicher, dass vorgegebene Prozesse konsequent eingehalten werden.

- Liquiditätssteuerung & Systemimplementierung: Du erlernst die Arbeit mit Agicap - unserem zentralen Werkzeug für Eingangs- und Ausgangsrechnungen, Zahlungsabläufe sowie das Liquiditätsmanagement. Zudem begleitest du den Rollout in unseren Tochtergesellschaften, schulst die Teams vor Ort und gewährleistest eine hohe Datenqualität und Vollständigkeit.

- Ad-hoc & Ops-Schnittstelle: Du packst auch mal an, wenn es brennt. Sei es bei Finance-nahen Sonderprojekten oder gelegentlicher Unterstützung im Ops-Bereich.

DU PASST GUT ZU UNS, WENN

- Du Ownership liebst und nicht wartest, bis jemand anderes eine Rechnung sucht, einen Fehler korrigiert oder einen Prozess aufräumt - du siehst es, du löst es.

- Du Buchungen nicht als lästiges Pflichtprogramm siehst, sondern verstehst, warum die Kontenwahl relevant ist - für das Reporting, für die Steuer, für das große Ganze.

- Du dich in einem Tool schnell zurechtfindest, das du vorher noch nie gesehen hast. Agicap, Moss, Lucanet, Datev - wenn du eines davon kennst, lernst du die anderen schnell.

- Du in Unklarheit handlungsfähig bleibst. In einem Startup sind Prozesse oft im Aufbau. Du baust mit, anstatt auf fertige Strukturen zu warten.

- Du Qualität mit Pragmatismus verbindest. Du machst es richtig - aber du weißt auch, wann „gut genug“ besser ist als „perfekt in drei Wochen“.

- Du fließend Deutsch und Englisch sprichst. Die Kommunikation mit unseren Steuerberatern und Tochtergesellschaften erfolgt auf Deutsch, während wir intern auf Englisch kommunizieren. Hard requirement.

- Du aus unserem Office in Prenzlauer Berg arbeiten willst. Das ist keine Remote-Rolle. Hard requirement.

WAS DU BEKOMMST

- Bis zu €500 Office-Nähe-Bonus, wenn du innerhalb von 10-20 Gehminuten zum Office wohnst (oder hinziehst).

- €110/Monat Mittagessen-Budget, €50 monatlicher Fitness-Zuschuss.

- €1.200 jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget.

- Kostenlose Bücher: Buena zahlt jedes Buch, das du lesen möchtest.

title: Customer Growth Manager
description:
Customer Growth Manager
Abous Us
KidKare is a growing software company, with a big heart and an even bigger vision - all thanks to the great people who work here. We offer a full-service Child and Adult Care Food Program (CACFP) software solution that helps centers plan menus, track attendance, and communicate with parents, all while claiming CACFP reimbursements on time. Today, more than 67,000 providers trust KidKare to keep them compliant with CACFP regulations. We are a 100% remote operation.
Position Summary
The Customer Growth Manager owns the full customer lifecycle - onboarding, retention, renewal, and expansion - for several hundred of KidKare's smallest sponsor accounts, assigned by state.
In the CACFP market, sponsor organizations are resource-constrained and focused on growing their own agencies. They rarely have the time to explore new features or optimize how they use their software. This role closes that gap at scale: getting new customers live quickly and correctly, keeping them engaged through tech-enabled and templated outreach, and surfacing the moments where an additional KidKare product or module would help them grow.
Success in this role looks less like deep individual account planning and more like disciplined execution across a large book. The two things that matter most are comfort operating at high account volume and rigorous adherence to established process. The ability to demonstrate software value quickly - in a 30-minute call, not a three-week engagement - is paramount.
Primary Responsibilities
At-Scale Onboarding

• Lead standardized, templated onboarding for newly-signed accounts in assigned states.

• Configure customer environments, guide basic data setup, and confirm customers are ready to independently process claims using KidKare.

• Execute against the onboarding standards, playbooks, and quality expectations set by the Enterprise Customer Growth Manager, escalating process gaps or edge cases rather than creating one-off approaches.

• Deliver group and self-serve training to move customers to competence efficiently.

At-Scale Retention & Renewal

• Serve as the primary KidKare point of contact for an assigned portfolio of several hundred small accounts.

• Own retention and renewal outcomes across the portfolio, pairing automated and personalized outreach to sustain engagement at volume.

• Monitor account health indicators (usage, adoption, support activity, claim volume) and prioritize outreach toward at-risk and high-opportunity accounts.

• Conduct renewal and pricing conversations, including communicating price adjustments, articulating value against cost, and securing renewal commitments within approved pricing guidelines.

• Escalate pricing exceptions and non-standard terms to the Senior or Enterprise Customer Growth Manager.

Growth & Expansion

• Proactively identify and close upsell and cross-sell opportunities across the portfolio, meeting or exceeding an assigned expansion quota.

• Execute outreach sequences and campaigns that surface growth opportunities without requiring individualized account planning for every customer.

• Develop working fluency in KidKare's product lines and match customer goals to relevant capabilities.

• Forecast expansion and retention activity and communicate progress clearly to your manager.

Process, Tooling & Knowledge

• Build in-depth working knowledge of the Child and Adult Care Food Program (CACFP) and of how sponsor organizations operate.

• Consistently log, update, and document all account activity in KidKare's CRM and CS enablement tools (HubSpot, Monday, Notion, SharePoint).

• Use AI and automation tooling to extend personal capacity across a high-volume book.

• Recommend improvements to onboarding templates, training materials, and outreach sequences based on patterns observed across the portfolio.

• Partner with Support to route technical issues appropriately and manage escalations to a clean resolution.

title: Senior COBOL Developer (z/OS) - LATAM Remote
description:
Workstate seeks a Senior COBOL Developer to join our team for an 18-month modernization project! In this role, you will convert a legacy RPG II codebase to COBOL on IBM z/OS in preparation for a cloud migration to Google Cloud Platform using the Raincode mainframe rehosting platform. If you are a strong COBOL engineer who enjoys working with data and delivering high-quality results for clients, you'll fit right in at Workstate .
We aim to engage consultants who can motivate and galvanize our clients, while diving deeply into the work at hand and envisioning future projects. Our consultants are skilled decision-makers, committed to championing client visions and driving quality results.
This position is fully remote and available to people residing in Colombia or Argentina with the right to work in that country.
Requirements
The ideal candidate will have 6+ years of professional COBOL development experience on IBM z/OS mainframes. Beyond that, we're looking for some of the following skills, but not necessarily all:

• Strong SQL and data skills, especially DB2 for z/OS (embedded SQL, query tuning, data modeling)

• JCL, TSO/ISPF and batch processing

• VSAM, QSAM/sequential files and GDGs

• Mainframe utilities such as DFSORT/SYNCSORT and IDCAMS

• CICS

• Legacy modernization, code conversion or mainframe migration projects

• Mainframe rehosting or emulation platforms (Raincode, Micro Focus/Rocket Enterprise Server) or GCP

• Source control and change management tools (Git, Endevor, ChangeMan)

• Data validation, reconciliation and parallel-run testing

• C1 level (advanced) or higher English, written and verbal. You will work directly with US-based client teams and need to communicate as comfortably as a US-based colleague.

You do not need RPG II experience. Engineers joining the project are trained on it. Prior experience with RPG II or other IBM midrange languages is a plus.
Job Duties

• Convert legacy RPG II programs into well-structured, maintainable COBOL on z/OS

• Analyze existing program logic, file layouts and data flows to make sure the converted code behaves the same way

• Develop and maintain JCL, batch job streams and related utilities

• Write and tune SQL (DB2 for z/OS) and work with VSAM and sequential datasets

• Take part in unit, regression and parallel testing, including data validation and reconciliation between legacy and converted output

• Prepare code and data for rehosting on GCP with the Raincode compiler and runtime

• Document converted programs, data dependencies and technical decisions

• Work with the client's technical and migration teams in an Agile setting

title: Business Control Manager
description:
About the role

We are hiring a Business Control Manager to join Chime’s Compliance Business Control Management team, with a primary focus on control delivery for Growth Marketing and Chime Enterprise. You will partner with business and control owners to translate agreed risk outcomes into practical controls that provide the right level of risk mitigation while working effectively for the business. You will also help bring Chime’s broader enterprise control environment to light by identifying, validating, and documenting controls that are already operating across the business. Along the way, you’ll have opportunities to contribute to larger Compliance BCM and business efforts based on priorities and capacity.

In this role, you can expect to

• Partner with Growth Marketing and Chime Enterprise business and control owners to translate agreed risk and control outcomes into practical implementation plans, while supporting additional Compliance BCM portfolios based on priorities and capacity.

• Contribute to reviews of business requirements, projects, process or product changes, incidents, complaints, and regulatory developments by identifying relevant controls, operating practices, gaps, dependencies, and implementation considerations.

• Drive assigned control workstreams through implementation, validation, documentation, and closure, coordinating milestones, dependencies, evidence, and routine decisions with business and control owners.

• Evaluate Chime’s existing control environment by reviewing business activities, procedures, system capabilities, evidence, and current control records to identify controls already operating and potential coverage gaps.

• Assess whether existing controls provide appropriate coverage and recommend whether controls should be reused, enhanced, created, consolidated, or retired.

• Evaluate implementation readiness, coordinate control owner attestations, validate assigned controls against team standards, and maintain complete and current control records.

• Track gaps, exceptions, remediation commitments, and dependencies through closure, escalating material design, ownership, exposure, or delivery concerns and supporting remediation arising from incidents, testing, audits, or other findings.

To thrive in this role, you have

• 4 or more years of experience in business controls, regulatory compliance, operational risk, audit, operations, or a related discipline within financial services, fintech, or another highly regulated environment.

• Hands-on experience taking a control or process improvement from a defined problem or requirement through implementation, evidence review, documentation, and closure.

• Strong analytical skills and experience evaluating business processes, requirements, incidents, and control records to understand what is operating, identify gaps, and determine where clarification or additional risk mitigation is needed.

• Strong execution and project-management skills, including managing multiple workstreams, dependencies, decisions, and stakeholders while adapting to changing complexity, urgency, and team priorities.

• Strong communication and influencing skills, with the ability to partner effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, challenge incomplete evidence or unclear ownership, and escalate material concerns with sound judgment.

• Experience working in consumer financial services or another regulated environment, with working knowledge of regulatory and consumer protection risk frameworks such as EFTA and Regulation E, TILA and Regulation Z, UDAAP, or comparable requirements.

title: Sales Development Manager
description:
ABOUT US

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.

With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.

Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

We’re hiring a Sales Development Manager (New York City or San Francisco) to lead and scale our founding SDR team at LangChain.

Our SDRs play a critical role in helping companies adopt LangChain and LangSmith. They engage technical buyers, convert high inbound interest into qualified opportunities, and work closely with our sales and marketing teams to build pipeline.

This role will own the performance, coaching, and development of the SDR team, while helping design the systems, processes, and workflows that power their GTM motion. You’ll partner closely with sales, marketing, and and RevOps to continuously improve how we identify and engage the right accounts.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

- Lead and coach a team of SDRs responsible for generating qualified pipeline

- Own SDR performance including activity metrics, conversion rates, pipeline creation, and attainment

- Recruit top SDR talent and grow the team as LangChain continues to scale

- Develop SDR talent through coaching, call reviews, and structured feedback

- Build repeatable outbound and inbound qualification playbooks

- Partner with marketing to convert inbound demand into qualified opportunities

- Work with sales leadership and RevOps to align on target accounts, territories, and pipeline goals

- Implement systems and workflows that improve SDR productivity and effectiveness

- Use data to continuously improve performance, analyzing conversion rates across the funnel

HOW TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE:

- Have 5+ years of experience in sales development

- Have 1-3+ years managing SDRs or leading a sales development team

- Are comfortable working with technical products and developer audiences

- Have experience with modern GTM tooling (AI Agents, LinkedIn Sales Nav, Power Dialers, etc.)

- Are highly data-driven and comfortable managing performance through metrics

- Are passionate about coaching and developing early-career sales talent

- Thrive in fast-moving environments where processes are still evolving

- Have strong communication and organizational skills

Compensation Philosophy:

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks.

We are hiring for this role across a range of scope, and the compensation band reflects that. Your offer depends on what we learn about your impact, craft, leadership, and communication during the interview process. We will tell you early where you’re tracking and talk comp with you before offer stage. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.

Team Leadership & Process Improvement

Required
